subject: expression: use parameter ctx to do evaluate instead of the inner one for all builtinFuncs (#48409)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent (911334b6ef7f548da6ef8ef90fc429c4c4c272b6), focusing on planner/executor/expression changes. The change removes `baseBuiltinFunc.ctx` and routes all builtin evaluation through the `ctx` parameter, with `ScalarFunction` now owning an inner `ctx` for legacy `Eval(row)` paths and assertions guarding against nil contexts in typed/vectorized eval entrypoints; planner/executor call sites previously passing nil were updated to pass session ctx. Searched for remaining nil-ctx eval call sites and for production `ScalarFunction{...}` literals missing `ctx:` initialization within the touched areas; none found. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` for follow-up fixes referencing this change; no related fix commits found.
